title: Preserve within-sector coherence in the full finite parity instrument
statement: For arbitrary changing bright contractions ||A_j||<=r and common quiet unitaries V_j, let theta=phi/N,c=cos(theta),s=sin(theta),q=rc,L=(1-q^N)/(1-q), D=N(1-c)+r*s^2*(N-L)/(1-q), alpha=sL,beta=rsL,gamma=q^N+r*s^2*(1-q^N)/(1-q)^2. The bright product blocks obey ||u-V||<=D,||v||<=alpha,||w||<=beta,||z||<=gamma. At phi=pi in the stated two-node interferometer, ||K_plus/minus-Pi_plus/minus*V||<=d/2 with d=D1+D2. For d<=1 failure probability<=d-d^2/2 and full flagged-instrument half-diamond error<=d/sqrt(2)+(d-d^2/2)/2. This holds jointly on arbitrary data-memory-reference inputs, not just for a parity bit. A residual risky output is routed to a real reject port; no nondestructive safe-rail detector is assumed.

requires: Qutrit levels 0,1,e, risky/safe optical modes, at most one photon and H_tap=I*H_M+(|e><1|b+h.c.)*G with 0<g_minus I<=G(t)<=g_plus I; finite-dimensional propagators; continuum limits need their own qualified convergence

The logical dark level and quiet/idle branches share the same memory propagator; positive integrated coupling windows, qualified optical rotations/routing and outgoing fresh vacuum drain modes are supplied
Bell attempts use actual fresh |++> preparations after failures; source preparation/reset, detection, earlier-output disconnection and full holding histories are paid and qualified
Full flagged instruments and joint effects are required, rather than correct parity probabilities or scalar-effect identities alone

assumptions: Qualified root-working finite optical-port model, not measured device performance, an acquired interface from the old signed spin handles, or practical advantage. Positive real exchange and a common quiet/dark/idle memory Hamiltonian, a supplied optical controller and single-photon source, real computational preparation, fresh outgoing drains, detection and holding are substantive requirements. Singular-value information alone, a sampled bath calibration, an auxiliary gap or a retained coherent drain is insufficient. Failed parity operations may flip live data and cannot be retried harmlessly. Scalar average loss/detection is not a uniform memory-independent qualification. The source retains stronger ordinary quantum-interrogation, cavity-scattering and filtered/offline optical comparators. No independent scientific audit of this new package is supplied.
costs: At N=64 and m=20 fresh drain collisions per tap: 128 taps +2560 drain windows +1 source window =2689 interaction windows per attempt, at most 2956.71 inverse-g_minus time units under the stated equal-duration window; rotations/routing/escape/readout/preparation/holding add costs

Illustrative source emission>=0.64, scalar memory-independent detector efficiency 0.9 and balanced transmission 0.999 per complete Zeno cycle are additional qualifications. Exact-rotation example gives Bell-infidelity<=0.0098605 and tap/drain success>=0.4291261; mean source attempts<=4.5985

With total optical-isometry budget 0.02: infidelity<=0.0179344, tap/drain success>=0.4033230 and mean source attempts<=4.8927. Cap61 gives erasure<8.77e-7 and <=164029 interaction windows plus all other operations

Ordinary sufficient optical calibration at eta=0.01,zeta=0.01 costs 211933 detected probes and 6781856 detected-probe passes at N=64, with about379910 prepared attempts under the illustrative loss/source model; branch qualification, SPAM and stability remain separate

Fixed balanced loss per cycle gives a worst-case unfiltered direct-factory cost obstruction Omega(epsilon^(-1/2)*exp(c*epsilon^(-1/2))); no lower bound on all optical/quantum protocols. Finite drains and optical precision cannot stay fixed at arbitrary requested accuracy
